summary: Single-file, dependency-free UI components that animate frame by frame; each one is a live demo, a HyperFrames video scene and copyable code, with real measurements · Tek dosyalık, kütüphanesiz, kare kare oynatılabilen arayüz parçaları; her biri canlı demo, HyperFrames video sahnesi ve kopyalanabilir kod
key_features: Seven single-file UI parts (odometer, prompt terminal, rope swing, status orb, contribution heat, code diff, progress ring), each with a live demo
One shared contract: mount, a pure seek(t), play, pause, destroy; randomness only from a seed, checked by a source scan
Each part is also a HyperFrames video scene with generated, schema-validated catalogue manifests
Real measurements in OLCUM.md; real phones and iOS Safari are stated as not measured

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written from the README; no field is generated from a guess
